author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Add Task (Corrected Path)
abstract: Correcting the file path error from eval 148. This script uses the full, explicit path to `create_task_script.py` within the subprocess call to ensure the sandbox can locate and execute it.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess

# Correctly executing the script with an explicit path from the sandbox root
command = [
    "python",
    "storage/telos/create_task_script.py", # This path is correct relative to the sandbox root.
    "--parent_id", "18",
    "--description", "Systematically review and analyze the contents of `storage/shared/agency_lab/`",
    "--tick", "66"
]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
